$comment: Configurable qualification collection rules. FAST PATH: Emma collects only the pre-link minimum over text, then sends the tokenized application link; the form collects the rest with chat answers prefilled. Widen 'collectable_fields' enabled flags to trade conversation length for text-collected data.

collectable_fields.$note: Collected on the prefilled application form instead of over text. Emma asks only for pre-link fields; everything else is entered once, on a screen built for it, with chat-collected values already filled in.

qualification_threshold.$comment: Set to null to disable auto-threshold behavior entirely. Met => Emma offers the application link; the form collects the remainder.

lead_creation_minimum.$comment: Journey A: minimum before creating a Salesforce Lead. Phone comes from the message itself.

$fast_path.$comment: Design note, not read by code. Conversation length == number of enabled collectable_fields, because Emma asks for missing_fields one at a time. Enabling a field costs one round trip over iMessage.
$fast_path.rationale: No knockout thresholds are configured, so revenue and time-in-business are data capture rather than qualification gates. Moving them to the form shortens intake without losing a decision.
$fast_path.to_lengthen: Re-enable a collectable field (e.g. monthly_gross_revenue) to have Emma ask for it before sending the link.

$questions_per_message_note: Emma may bundle up to this many closely-related questions in one message (e.g. business name + amount). Set to 1 to restore strict one-at-a-time behavior.
